summary: What this player's game draws of the plates above players, and short labels resources add above them. None of this is sent to others. What the server sets on a plate with Player.setNameplate* comes with the player. A label belongs to the resource that set it, and goes when that resource stops.

setVisible.summary: Shows or hides all plates on this screen.
setVisible.exampleLua:
-- client
local Nameplates, Key = kcds.ui.Nameplates, kcds.ui.Key

Key.bind("f8", function()
  Nameplates.setVisible(not Nameplates.isVisible())
end)

isVisible.summary: Whether plates show on this screen. True by default.

setHealthVisible.summary: Shows or hides health bars on this screen.

isHealthVisible.summary: Whether health bars show on this screen.

isNameVisible.summary: Whether names show on this screen. With health bars alone, each bar takes its name's place.

getMode.summary: What a plate shows on this screen: 'both', 'name', 'health' or 'none'.

setSelfVisible.summary: Shows or hides the local player's own plate.

isSelfVisible.summary: Whether the local player's own plate shows. False by default.

setLabel.summary: Adds a short line above an entity's plate on this screen. '' removes it.

params.text: The line, up to 256 UTF-8 bytes.
params.durationMs: How long it shows, 6000 by default and up to an hour. 0 or less keeps it until cleared.
params.color: A packed 0xAARRGGBB, or 0, the default, for the plate's colour.

setLabel.exampleLua:
-- client: yellow text above another player's plate for six seconds
kcds.core.Events.on("trade:offer", function(offer)
  kcds.ui.Nameplates.setLabel(offer.playerId, "Wants to trade", 6000, 0xffffff00)
end)

clearLabel.summary: Removes the label from one entity.

setNameVisible.summary: Shows or hides names on this screen.

setMode.summary: Sets what a plate shows on this screen: 'both', 'name', 'health' or 'none'.
